picks.title: Pennsylvania will require labels on AI-generated ads
picks.rationale: Pennsylvania's AI Deceptive Advertising Act puts a disclosure requirement on AI-generated ad creative, which changes how brands and agencies running AI-made ads in the state must label them, loopholes included.
picks.excerpt: Pennsylvania’s AI Deceptive Advertising Act leaves a lot of loopholes.

picks.title: IAB Tech Lab extends AI ad-buying standard comments to November 10
picks.rationale: IAB Tech Lab extended public comment on its 71-field agentic ad-buying draft standard to November 10, giving buyers, sellers and agent builders 49 days instead of 30 to shape how AI agents will transact media.
picks.excerpt: Window on the 71-field draft now runs 49 days, not 30, for buyers, sellers and agent builders. Machine-readable schemas still wait on what comments change.

picks.title: Explore new ways to drive your best ROI with the first Google Marketing Platform Drop
picks.rationale: Google's first monthly Marketing Platform Drop adds a DV360 Marketplace where Gemini curates personalized media bundles for live sports and tentpole events, bought in one click, plus a Gemini-driven Search Ads 360 Home. Both put AI directly into how media is planned and bought.
picks.excerpt: Google's first monthly Marketing Platform Drop adds a Display & Video 360 Marketplace where Gemini models curate personalized media bundles for live sports and tentpole events, activated in one click. It also adds a Search Ads 360 Home view that uses Gemini to consolidate insights, generate suggestions, and streamline execution.

dedup.note: Final: 3 picks, which meets the floor of 3; no padding. The fact-check dropped PPC Land 'IAB Europe finds 86% use AI for marketing, but only 48% have ad rules': the underlying IAB Europe study came out 2026-09-24 at DMEXCO, a month-old event and stale for the 72h window. No backfill: every remaining candidate was already rejected on content or dedup grounds. Those are the AdExchanger OpenAI creative enhancements (repeat of SER 10-21), SER Universal Cart live (repeat of TechCrunch 10-16), Omnicom and Meta Q3 earnings (business noise), Digiday Target holiday (rejected 10-22/10-24), SER Translation Tool (AI angle not stated), SER Customer Lifecycle Goals (fails delete-AI), PPC Land Google/Meta EU fine analysis (analysis of published terms changes), Adweek Tilly Norwood (interview, no action), PPC Land Meta AI terms delay (date-only follow-up, text unchanged), SER AI search studies and PPC Land AI Overviews 88% (organic SEO, one cluster). Earlier in the run, Pennsylvania was kept in marketing after politics dropped it, and the GMP Drop was added from the recovery pass. Outlets: The Verge 1, PPC Land 1, Google Blog 1.
